Thirteen comments

The source

This tune was composed by clare fiddler Frankie Gavin.

↳ Posted by JD on July 1st, 2001.

Great tune!

Lunasa does a great job on this tune in B minor together with Terry “Cuz” Teahan’s. It’s also nice to play this tune in both keys in a row.

↳ Posted by craics90 on January 27th, 2005.

Gavin

Frankie Gavin is from Corrandulla Co. Galway.
( originally ). The family moed into town ( Galway City ) when Frankie was pup.

Pat

↳ Posted by Pat Higgins on May 28th, 2007.

Pat, I posted the above bit of info into the McGoldrick tune Road to Corrandulla - hope you don’t mind me using your info.

↳ Posted by Donough on May 28th, 2007.

Funnily enough, he doesn’t play fiddle or flute in the East Galway style.

↳ Posted by slainte on May 29th, 2007.

Thoughts

I’ve been meaning to learn this tune. Franky plays this tune in d minor on the recording I have. Joanie madden plays it in b minor as noted above, so does Lunasa. Sounds pretty nice in A minor and g minor too.

↳ Posted by madfluter on August 21st, 2008.

Nice, sensibly sensitive Em/GM shift!

↳ Posted by birlibirdie on April 1st, 2010.

“Paddy Cronin’s”, X:2

Definitely composed by Frankie Gavin, but given to me as Paddy Cronin’s. Lovely reel none the less, this particular setting could also be slowed and swung into a barndance.

Strange that nobody mentioned that it’s a stand-alone clip on the classic “Frankie Goes to Town.” Frankie plays flute as well as the fiddle on this CD.
